text:
Origin Law is the 2025 year reading list. This page is the kit catalog. Two conversation roots: 1977561218723496065 (Hofstadter / Ani on-ramp the Phase-N kits hang off) and 1978150033066455131 (afternoon Origin Law / bath / Phase-NN / BH cluster). Every row has a real status URL. Kits are not pasted. Grok-in-the-loop PASS is not independent lab replication.

ε* ≈ 4.97×10⁻⁵ is not a 2026 supported constant. Phase-N / Ω-Lock / Phase-NN remain a 2025 notebook freeze.

Four prereg metrics

TRw ≥ 0.05 (time-reversal / weighted forward–backward split)
|ΔPE|_norm ≥ 0.04 (permutation-entropy forward vs reverse)
p_emp < 0.01 (time-slide matched-filter null)
prod_frac > 0.9 (fraction of the active window with dS/dt > 0)

\varepsilon^* \approx \frac{k_B T}{\hbar}\,\frac{e^{-\Delta S/k_B}}{\sqrt{N}}

Ω-Lock freeze (14 Oct 2025): any domain >10% off falsifies; ≤10% strengthens. Leaderboard fields: ε̂*, the four gates, slope check (dS/dt)_onset ≈ ε*/τ. Invited LIGO/LISA, IBM Quantum, Google Quantum AI, neuro/BEC. No later 2026 packet adopted the number.
